root = Col([panel])
$favorites = []
$photo = -1
$booking = ""
panel = Box([heading, cards, collage, viewer, booking, disclaimer], "col", 6, 5, "#ffffff", "xl", true, "100%")
heading = Title("Modern Hotels in Paris", "xl", "#111111")
cards = Carousel(@Each(hotels, "h", Box([Pressable([Image(photos[h.photo], "演示建筑照片，不对应真实酒店", 1.5, "lg", "cover")], @Set($photo, h.photo), false, 0), Row([Badge(h.tag, h.color, h.icon)], 1), Text(h.name, "md", "#111111", "semibold"), Box([Text(h.description, "sm", "#666666", "normal", false, false, false, 3)], "col", 0, 0, null, null, false, "100%", 64), Row([Pressable([Text("Book", "sm", "#ffffff", "semibold")], @Set($booking, h.name), false, 2, "#000000", "full"), Pressable([Icon("heart", "md", @Includes($favorites, h.name) ? "#e44967" : "#222222")], @Set($favorites, @Toggle($favorites, h.name)), @Includes($favorites, h.name), 2, @Includes($favorites, h.name) ? "#fff0f4" : "#f8f8f8", "full")], 2)], "col", 2, 2, "#ffffff", "xl", true, "100%")), 232, 3)
collage = Grid([Pressable([Image(photos[1], "演示建筑主图", 1.23, "sm", "cover")], @Set($photo, 1), false, 0), Grid(@Each([0, 2, 3, 4], "i", Pressable([Image(photos[i], "演示建筑照片 " + (i + 1), 1.25, "sm", "cover")], @Set($photo, i), false, 0)), 2, null, 1)], 2, null, 1)
viewer = $photo >= 0 ? Col([Row([Caption("照片 " + ($photo + 1) + " / 5 · 演示素材"), Spacer(), IconButton("x", @Set($photo, -1), "收起大图", "ghost")], 2), Image(photos[$photo], "放大的演示建筑照片，不对应真实酒店", 1.5, "lg", "contain"), Row([Button("上一张", @Set($photo, ($photo + 4) % 5), "outline", null, "sm", "chevron-left"), Spacer(), Button("下一张", @Set($photo, ($photo + 1) % 5), "outline", null, "sm", "chevron-right")], 2)], 2) : null
booking = $booking != "" ? Box([Row([Text($booking, "md", "#111111", "semibold"), Spacer(), IconButton("x", @Set($booking, ""), "收起预订演示", "ghost")], 2), Text("预订交互演示：以下为 example.com 占位链接，非酒店官网，不会创建订单。", "sm", "muted"), Link("打开占位链接 ↗", "https://example.com")], "col", 2, 3, "#f6f6f6", "lg") : null
disclaimer = Caption("DEMO · 文案按参考图展示，未经酒店资料核验。全部照片为演示素材，不对应真实酒店。" + (@Count($favorites) > 0 ? " 已收藏 " + @Count($favorites) + " 家（仅当前界面）。" : ""))
hotels = [{name: "Hotel Plaza Athénée", photo: 0, tag: "Free Wifi", color: "success", icon: "wifi", description: "Haute couture suites; courtyard dining; Dior spa; near Champs-Élysées."}, {name: "Four Seasons George V", photo: 1, tag: "Family-friendly", color: "purple", icon: "heart", description: "Landmark hotel with opulent rooms, Michelin dining, and a lavish spa."}, {name: "Shangri-La Paris", photo: 2, tag: "Spa", color: "info", icon: "waves", description: "Eiffel Tower views from a former palace; pool and two-star dining."}]
photos = ["https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1613977257363-707ba9348227?w=960&q=80", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1600607687920-4e2a09cf159d?w=960&q=80", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1571896349842-33c89424de2d?w=960&q=80", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1487958449943-2429e8be8625?w=960&q=80", "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511818966892-d7d671e672a2?w=960&q=80"]
